title: Focus Triad Evidence Report
description: Structured evidence report emitted by scripts/focus/focus.py and consumed by the /focus-plan workflow. The report is the deterministic, incorruptible substitute for the per-item SEARCH EVIDENCE blocks /focus-plan formerly asked the agent to hand-write.

workspace.description: Resolved absolute path to the scanned workspace.

plan_file.description: Resolved path to the located plan, or null.

plan_spelling.description: Which filename matched: 'hyphen' = canonical implementation-plan.md, 'underscore' = legacy implementation_plan.md, 'explicit' = --plan override.

checkboxes.description: Plan-level task checkbox tally. Orphaned open/in-progress tasks are a /triage signal.

source_line.description: 1-based line of the item's header in the plan.

raw.description: Token as written in the plan.

query.description: Normalized search term used against the substrate.

locations.description: Up to 5 substrate locations (relpath or relpath:Lnn) where the anchor was found.

production_matches.description: Symbol anchors only: hit count outside test/mock paths.

test_matches.description: Symbol anchors only: hit count inside test/mock paths.

absent_anchors.description: Anchors not found in the substrate. Ghost Logic CANDIDATES — the agent must classify each as true Ghost Logic vs a legitimately not-yet-built item.

mock_trap_candidates.description: Symbols found ONLY under test/mock/fixture paths. Mock Trap candidates: the item looks implemented but only its test double exists.

present.description: Anchors verified present in production substrate.

verdict_hint.description: ADVISORY ONLY. RED = plan missing or a Mock Trap candidate exists; YELLOW = coverage gaps to adjudicate; GREEN = all anchors present in production. The agent owns the final verdict.

tasks_md.description: [schema 1.1] tasks.md + BUILD_RECEIPTS.md phase status, the mechanical fact PHASE 2 adjudication uses to tell a legitimately not-yet-built item (PENDING) apart from Ghost Logic (MISMATCH). found=false means tasks.md does not exist — the plan has no execution phases yet, so absences are presumptively PENDING.

receipts_file_found.description: Whether .workflow_state/receipts/BUILD_RECEIPTS.md exists. False does not penalize a phase — not every workspace uses the receipts pipeline.

phases.description: One entry per 'Phase N' / 'Stage N' titled header found in tasks.md. Empty does not necessarily mean no phases exist — it can mean tasks.md uses a naming convention this parser does not recognize; treat empty as 'structure not recognized', not 'no phases'.

source_line.description: 1-based line of the phase header in tasks.md.

status.description: Derived purely from this phase's own checkbox tally.

receipt_status.description: Cross-reference against BUILD_RECEIPTS.md by normalized phase-name match. found_complete + status=complete is the strongest 'safe to treat absence as Ghost Logic' signal. status=complete with receipt_status=not_found (checkboxes say done, no matching receipt exists despite the file being present) is a discrepancy worth flagging on its own — not an automatic verdict either way.
